WHAT: Two retrieval threshold changes to make vector similarity more useful for casual/conversational queries.

WHERE: src/core/retriever.ts (or similar — check grep for VECTOR_THRESHOLD)

HOW:
- Vector signal fires at >= 30% cosine similarity (was 40%)
- If vector similarity >= 50%, memory activates even without a second signal (bypasses 2-signal gate)
- Previously: 'curating' + 'embeddings' in message couldn't activate anything because vector scores maxed at ~22%
- After change: 'curation pipeline? it works?' immediately activated the pipeline overhaul memory

WHY: The 2-signal gate + 40% threshold was too strict for natural language queries. Strong semantic match should be sufficient on its own.

GOTCHA: The 30% threshold may cause false positives for very short/generic messages. Monitor for noise.
